displayedInputs.question:
From the 8 vertices of a rectangular prism, select the 2 endpoints of an edge. Are these two points and the midpoint of the edge collinear? Answer 1 if they are collinear and 0 if they are not.

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

In a rectangular prism, consider an edge of the top base and an edge of the bottom base that is neither parallel to it nor in the same lateral face. These edges:

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

The top and bottom bases of a rectangular prism are parallel. A lateral face has a line of intersection with each of these two bases. Are these two lines of intersection parallel? Answer 1 if they are parallel and 0 if they are not.

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

What is the relationship between a lateral edge of a rectangular prism and its base?

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

choices.D: The edge lies in the base

displayedInputs.question:
A rectangular prism has 4 lateral edges, all perpendicular to its base. Are two adjacent lateral edges parallel? Answer 1 if they are parallel and 0 if they are not.

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

After one face of a cube is designated as the base, how many faces are perpendicular to this base?

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

Two adjacent lateral faces of a rectangular prism are both perpendicular to the base. How many lateral edges perpendicular to the base lie in one of these lateral faces (count only that face's own lateral edges)?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

In a rectangular prism, one edge has direction vector \((4,0,0)\), and another edge has direction vector \((0,3,0)\). What is their dot product?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
